messages:
alex_prod: customer reports requests that used to work started returning tool lookup errors after a recent model/tool rename. example error: `tool_not_registered`. they said nothing changed on their side.
lee_support: can you paste the raw request + response (incl. trace_id) and which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)? also pinging @samir_oncall for infra visibility. :eyes:
alex_prod: hosted API, region us-west-2. here's a redacted curl that reproduces it:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","tool":"Image_Resize-V2","args":{"width":800,"height":600}}'
```

response (body):
```
{"error":"tool_not_registered","code":404,"message":"tool key not found: Image_Resize-V2","trace_id":"tr-0a1b2c3d"}
```

alex_prod: note the client is sending `Image_Resize-V2` (mixed case). the registry currently lists `image_resize-v2` after the rename.
lee_support: thanks. can you also attach the SDK/client version? question: did the customer call an alias or the canonical tool key?
alex_prod: they used the SDK (js) v2.4.1, which we know normalizes keys in most cases but not for older alias formats. they passed the name they saw in the UI pre-rename.
samir_oncall: looking at infra logs for trace tr-0a1b2c3d... pulling registry and gateway logs.
registry-bot: registry-sync job last successful run: 2026-11-10T02:11:07Z. last run attempted: 2026-11-12T15:02:01Z (failed). failure reason: deadlock during migration step #34. backlog shows ~120 pending alias writes.
samir_oncall: gateway logs show cache hit for alias `Image_Resize-V2` -> MISS. lookup fallback to registry -> registry returned 404 for that key. registry does have `image_resize-v2` and an alias mapping `img-resize-v2` but no mixed-case alias.
lee_support: so plausible root cause: registry and gateway canonicalization drift after a failed sync/migration. without the mixed-case alias present, clients that send legacy-cased keys get 404.
emily_runtime: confirmed. during the migration we changed the canonical store to lowercase keys (to reduce duplicates) but the alias backfill step that copies legacy-cased aliases into lowercase form failed and was not retried due to the deadlock. result: some aliases were never written and the gateway cache still treats incoming tool keys as case-sensitive. immediate remediation options:
- manual alias insert for the affected keys (fast, low-risk)
- run registry-sync backfill with increased lock timeout and monitor (medium)
- change gateway to use case-insensitive compare for a transitional period (riskier, needs rollout)

emily_runtime: quick workaround I can do now: insert alias `Image_Resize-V2` pointing to canonical `image_resize-v2` in the registry and invalidate gateway alias cache for that key. steps I will run:
1) POST /internal/registry/aliases {"alias":"Image_Resize-V2","target":"image_resize-v2"} (auth: internal service token)
2) POST /internal/cache/invalidate {"key":"aliases:image_resize-v2"}

lee_support: please run and paste responses. i'll tell the customer we're triaging and expecting a short fix window.
emily_runtime: ran step 1 -> 201 Created. ran step 2 -> 200 OK. gateway reported next request trace tr-0a1b2c3d -> routed to backend, success. :white_check_mark:
alex_prod: customer confirmed immediate success after we applied alias and cache invalidation. thanks.
lee_support: escalation notes: root cause = registry sync/migration deadlock left alias backfill incomplete causing casing-sensitive lookups to fail. immediate mitigation = manual alias backfill + cache invalidate. proposed medium-term fixes: retry/backfill job on migration failures, add integration test for casing/alias propagation, and consider gateway transitional case-insensitive matching.
samir_oncall: created internal ticket RINF-4521 for backfill + migration retry and assigned to eng-runtime. set priority P1 since customer outage occurred. scheduled the backfill for 2026-11-13 01:00 UTC with a post-check.
lee_support: I'll update the customer with root cause and mitigation and include repro steps + timeline. follow-up: add monitoring alert for registry-sync failures that have >1 day of pending alias writes.
alex_prod: customer asked for postmortem; set expectation for next-day writeup. thanks team. :heart:
